visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows hands pouring a heavy amount of dried green cilantro flakes from a bright green packet onto a block of light green instant noodles in a clear glass bowl. Text on screen announces a new Costco product. (2) A male character with long curly hair and a brown and teal corduroy jacket holds a green packet of 'Cilantro Beef Noodle Soup'. He looks at the camera with an expression of intense curiosity and excitement. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of the dry noodle block, which is a vivid green color, emphasizing the vegetable component. (4) The character adds seasoning packets, including a red chili paste and soup powder, onto the noodles before pouring in hot liquid and covering the bowl with a glass lid. (5) The character is shown eating the cooked noodles from a small white bowl in a modern kitchen setting. He reacts with wide eyes and animated facial expressions, speaking directly to the viewer. (6) A close-up shows the green noodles being lifted by chopsticks, dripping with soup and covered in herbs. (7) A new preparation is shown on a white plate: dry noodles topped with a sunny-side-up egg and a generous amount of fresh green cilantro. (8) The character uses chopsticks to break the egg yolk and mix it into the noodles. He takes a large bite, laughing and gesturing wildly with his hands as he reacts to the strong flavor profile. (9) The video ends with him laughing and talking enthusiastically while holding the plate, standing in the kitchen background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 好市多新品. [Subtitle]: 維力香菜牛肉麵. (2) [Subtitle]: 上面還寫著. 香菜實物添加. (3) [Variety]: 真的假的啦. (4) [Subtitle]: 麵是綠色的!. (5) [Subtitle]: 是菠菜粉. (6) [Slogan]: 好食哦 老董 (老董詩服愛心愛心). (7) [Subtitle]: 重頭戲來了哦. 直接給你個香菜包. (8) [Variety]: 量很多欸. 哇! 太多了啦. (9) [Subtitle]: 我已經看不到麵了. (10) [Subtitle]: 一開始那個沖的香菜味道真的很濃烈. 剛好打到愛香菜人的心. 可以帶出牛肉湯底的鹹味. 很好吃 只是說 那個菠菜沒有味道啦. (11) [Variety]: 菠菜就是噱頭. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們來個大升級. 加入半熟蛋、新鮮香菜作成乾拌麵. 哇嗚! 把蛋黃爆拌在一起. (13) [Subtitle]: 乾燥跟新鮮的香菜加在一起 等於兩面牆把我夾殺 有點太可怕. (14) [Subtitle]: 蛋汁可以把新舊的香菜融合在麵上. (15) [Variety]: 越 越 越 有 那 個 味 道. (16) [Subtitle]: 本來想說臭味的 但是怕傷害大家感情 (還是說了).

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and energetic electronic BGM begins instantly. A male speaker introduces the cilantro noodle product with a high pitch and rapid speech rate. Sound of plastic crinkling as he opens the package. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The speaker's arousal level is high, characterized by enthusiastic exclamations and rising intonation. (3) Percussive thud sounds occur as the dry noodles are placed in a bowl. BGM remains continuous with a strong, danceable beat. (4) Tearing and squeezing sounds of seasoning packets are heard, interspersed with the speaker's humorous commentary on the quantity of cilantro. (5) Liquid splashing sounds as soup is prepared. The speaker's tone shifts to a critical yet comedic review, enunciating words clearly. (6) Loud slurping and chewing sounds are central as he tastes the noodles. The speaker laughs and speaks with high pitch variability. (7) Sound effects of 'bubbles' and comical 'boing' sounds accompany the introduction of the egg. The speaker's voice becomes even more animated. (8) Sound of chopsticks mixing and a plate clinking. The speaker concludes with a high-energy verdict and a loud laugh, as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously review a new and polarizing food product (cilantro beef noodles) from Costco, demonstrating its preparation and suggesting ways to enhance the flavor for cilantro enthusiasts.
